# function: wo_version

Returns a stable positive integer derived from the SHA-256 of the ciphertext (whitespace ignored). Use it as a *_wo_version argument so the write-only value is re-sent automatically whenever the secret is re-encrypted. Hashes the ciphertext only; reveals nothing about the plaintext and needs no key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  django_env_ct = file("${path.module}/secrets/prod.env.enc")
}

ephemeral "secret_secret" "django_env" {
  ciphertext = local.django_env_ct
}

resource "google_secret_manager_secret_version" "django_env" {
  secret         = google_secret_manager_secret.django_env.id
  secret_data_wo = ephemeral.secret_secret.django_env.plaintext

  # Changes exactly when the file is re-encrypted -> the new value is pushed.
  secret_data_wo_version = provider::secret::wo_version(local.django_env_ct)
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
wo_version(ciphertext string) number
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `ciphertext` (String) The SECRET1;... value (the same one passed to secret_secret).
